recovered_sources.notes: All 66 prior frozen requirement IDs and source locators are durably available. They are not assumed to be identical to or a subset mapping of the new 110-row ownership corpus until the 110 source is recovered.

owner_boundary.system_master: product orchestration/cross-system user-intent routing/integration admission/product completion

crosswalk_rules: Do not renumber or synthesize the new 110-row corpus from the prior 66.
Do not assume the numerical difference of 44 identifies 44 specific missing requirements.
Match prior rows to the new corpus only by exact recovered identity, explicit supersession link, or evidence-backed semantic equivalence recorded row by row.
One prior row may split into multiple new rows; multiple prior rows may merge only with explicit current adjudication.
Historical graph/dependency/assessment PASS remains evidence for its exact historical subject and does not transfer to the ownership-freeze subject.
Interface archaeology may seed row recovery but cannot be inflated into 110 interfaces by counting fields, commands or events arbitrarily.

Semantic-object rows must come from an authoritative current/user-directed source or be individually proposed and later adjudicated; they may not be reverse-counted from runtime classes to force a denominator of 26.

targeted_research_disposition.reason: The current blocker is internal source identity for the user-defined 110/110/26 corpus. External pedagogy research cannot recover those row identities and would risk design drift before ownership is locked.
targeted_research_disposition.research_reopen_rule: Use external research only after exact row recovery when an ownership/design decision remains evidence-sensitive.
